First256-byte text heuristic and UTF8 decoding with replacement can miss UTF16 or unconventional encodings. Offsets are decoded character offsets, not byte offsets.

Named-token absence does not exclude separately defined aliases, token-pasting, indirect function pointers, dynamic/code-generated symbol names or missing native sources. Tokens include prefix/suffix variants and linker/helper/declaration names; these are not all canonical API invocations.

Lexical disposition does not establish active runtime use or kind/buffer provenance. Generated Cython/vendor/compatibility, inactive preprocessor branches, comments/docs/macros, .sip/.c.src and Python strings need contextual semantic review. Classification is separate from this audit.
